title: Tatooine Utility Belt
caption: Tatooine Utility Belt (V)
game_text: Deploy on Han or a Lars. Character cannot be targeted by {permanent-weapon} weapons or be captured. If just lost, place this device in Used Pile. Force loss from ...Or Be Destroyed must come from Reserve Deck (if possible) and may not be reduced below 2.
game_text_lines:
Deploy on Han or a Lars. Character cannot be targeted
by {permanent-weapon} weapons or be captured. If just lost, place this
device in Used Pile. Force loss from ...Or Be Destroyed
must come from Reserve Deck (if possible) and may
not be reduced below 2.
lore: Survival gear, food and tools are stored in small compartments. Made from bantha hide. Used by Luke and other Tatooine inhabitants.

notes: Group: Farming. Bottom-half slip: banner DEVICE, text box, VS15 sphere bottom-right. INLINE black square with green lightsaber after 'by' = Permanent Weapon icon (Rev 8) → {permanent-weapon} (stub: 'Weapon icon'). '...Or Be Destroyed' — three periods as printed (the card title …Or Be Destroyed). CREDITS printed in italics under the text box: left 'Original concept by Joe Olson', right 'Alderaan Regionals 2006' → credit_bottom. Not unique (no dot), as printed. Slip text matches the stub. Lore matches wiki and scan. Base scan 350 px only; copyright Premiere 1995 read off the scan. Modern: VB1-L-tatooineutilitybelt-pre.gif (Virtual Block 1 reissue of this slip; it prints 'from Or Be Destroyed' without the dots).
